purpose: One independently authored surreal concept, not a control-level calibration experiment.
concept: Soft solid-marble curtain in an alteration room
requester_owned_topic: Explicit prior-user surreal topic carried by the coordinator-frozen topic context.
authorial_realization: A solid mineral sheet behaves like loose fabric while a person lifts its lower corner.
reference_scope: Face and hair appearance only; no identity, actual age or personality inference.
competing_readings: A rigid stone sculpture already carved into curtain folds

gates.criterion: The broad curtain and its held edge read as the same solid mineral, including continuous gray veins and an exposed thick mineral/chipped cross-section; printed fabric alone fails.
gates.evidence: The continuous gray veins, pale crystalline-looking surface and rough exposed thick lower section provide a mineral-like appearance across the same sheet. A true material assay is unavailable.

gates.criterion: The mineral-looking curtain visibly has deep cloth-like folds and its held lower corner curls around the fingers in one still state; a rigid-looking carved silhouette without the intended contact and curl fails this visual criterion. This does not prove actual material softness or motion.
gates.evidence: Deep cloth-like folds and a lifted corner are visible, but the thick mineral-looking edge does not clearly curl around the fingers as preregistered. It hangs below a fingertip pinch; the full relation cannot pass.

gates.criterion: The stone identity cues and soft cloth behavior coexist on one continuous curtain, with the person's actual hand contacting its lifted edge.
gates.evidence: The contacted lifted edge belongs to the same continuous sheet that carries the gray mineral veins and broad folds. The person's arm and hand visibly connect to that edge.

gates.criterion: Face and short dark bob with fine wispy bangs are visibly guided by the supplied reference; this is appearance guidance, not verified identity.
gates.evidence: Short dark bob, fine wispy bangs, dark eyes and a softly rounded face are consistent with face-and-hair guidance from the supplied portrait. Identity and actual age are not assessed.

separate_evidence_layers: New CID source review and inspiration decision
Whole-source native qualification if independently earned
evidence_limit: A still image can support co-visible forms, mineral-like appearance, folds, curl, cross-section and contact. It cannot establish actual physical material, ductility, a deformation process or real motion.
overall_reason: Three visible topic/reference criteria are supported, but the pre-registered finger-wrapping mineral edge is only partially visible. partial_is_fail is preserved.

supplemental_comparator.evidence: A straight-edged rectangular mineral-looking offcut stands upright on the stool beside the shears, distinct from the curling sheet.
supplemental_comparator.origin: Generic normal-comparison strategy inspired by cand_0b7f9c9489ca5fd9bf6be56768448b47; original sewn-doorway case NOT_TESTED.
